senses.gloss: f. (scortea, sub. vestis; v. אִיסְקוֹרְטְיָא) leather coat;also leather apron.
units: Kel. XVI, 4 (Maim. leather table-cover, v. צִיצָה). Ib. XXVI, 5 (6) עור ס׳ the skin intended for a scortea. Ohol. VIII, 1 ס׳ a leather bed-sheet.

Tosef. Sabb. V (VI), 14. Ned. 55ᵇ, [read as:] Y. ib. VII, end, 40ᶜ; Tosef. ib. IV, 3Ned. 55ᵇ, [read as:] Y. ib. VII, end, 40ᶜ; Tosef. ib. IV, 3 איסק׳; a. e. [Ned. l. c. מאי איסק׳ כיתונא דצלא scortea is a leather coat.]
